authority.statusRule: Recovered family action and P0-P6 implementation names are CONFIRMED within their source scope. Mathematical machinery and operating doctrine introduced here are DERIVED unless separately adopted; numeric constants are PROPOSED unless sourced.

mathematics.topologyState: Represent a candidate fold as T_f={Omega_o,Omega_d,Phi_f,Gamma_f,tau_c}, where origin and destination protected volumes are mapped to temporary adjacency by Phi_f over commit interval tau_c.
mathematics.routeObjective: J_F=w_d*d_Mprime(A,B)+w_c*C_cov+w_o*C_occ+w_g*C_grav+w_u*C_unc+w_r*C_rec, minimized only across admissible topology solutions.
mathematics.endpointCovariance: Sigma_end=J_x Sigma_nav J_x^T + Sigma_grav + Sigma_ref + Sigma_model. Candidate solutions are rejected when projected endpoint confidence intersects excluded geometry or exceeds authority thresholds.
mathematics.occupancyExclusion: E_occ=integral_Omega_d rho_occ(x)*w(x) dV. Any confirmed occupied protected-volume intersection is a hard veto, not a weighted inconvenience.
mathematics.commitBoundary: Before t_commit, candidate topology may be re-solved, rejected, or aborted. After topology execution begins, meaningful steering is negligible by recovered canon; control authority shifts to completion, isolation, and recovery.
mathematics.safetyHorizon: T_precommit >= t_detect+t_auth+t_solve+t_crosscheck+t_command+t_field+t_margin. Higher Path improves the last safe correction instant but never guarantees safety.

pathStages.name: Adjacency Test Monolith
pathStages.breakthrough: Microscopic temporary adjacency between nearby bounded regions.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Monumental fixed aperture rings, topology supports and sacrificial waveguides.

pathStages.name: Cargo Fold Chamber
pathStages.limit: Fixed chamber geometry and short baselines.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Closed fold-volume panels, boundary references and dedicated sinks.

pathStages.name: Orbital Fold Gate
pathStages.breakthrough: Stable correspondence between separated prepared endpoint volumes.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Authenticated ranging, dual endpoint certification and paired reference alignment.

pathStages.name: Capital Fold-Jump Core
pathStages.breakthrough: Moving-origin shipboard topology with remote adjacency.
pathStages.limit: Hard commit boundary and high machinery burden.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Topology waveguides, aperture rings, gravimetry and recovery dampers.

pathStages.name: Fleet Fold Drive
pathStages.breakthrough: Generate and rank multiple admissible endpoint solutions under uncertainty.
pathStages.limit: Destination covariance and exclusion geometry remain binding.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Redundant solvers, endpoint sensors and sectional field hardware.

pathStages.name: Strategic Long-Fold Engine
pathStages.breakthrough: Gravity-conditioned long-baseline topology solving with explicit covariance.
pathStages.limit: Reference provenance, structural authority and endpoint uncertainty still constrain range.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Higher-authority field media, stronger support structure and deep-range reference networks.

pathStages.name: Compact Tactical Fold Core
pathStages.breakthrough: Continuous compact adjacency re-solve until the last safe commit instant.
pathStages.utility: Capital-quality fold selection from much smaller platforms.
pathStages.limit: Not unlimited range; topology and recovery authority remain finite.
pathStages.engineeringAdvance: Dense field media, local gravimetry and fast recovery architecture.

machinery.function: Accumulate, isolate and shape the fold event energy while protecting abort reserve.
machinery.embodimentRule: Must expose charge, isolation and recovery reserve separately.
machinery.failureExposure: Bus collapse, asymmetric delivery, reserve theft.

machinery.function: Initiate the exotic/topological state needed for adjacency.
machinery.embodimentRule: Technology basis changes physical actuator but not the required topology action.

machinery.function: Define the protected origin volume and fold boundary.
machinery.embodimentRule: Coverage must include every payload element intended to transfer.
machinery.failureExposure: Coverage hole, boundary asymmetry, clipped appendage.

machinery.function: Shape and hold the selected adjacency solution through commit.
machinery.embodimentRule: Precommit control is high-value; postcommit steering authority is minimal.
machinery.failureExposure: Late solution drift, sector disagreement, premature commit.

machinery.function: Resolve destination state, gravity environment, occupancy and covariance.
machinery.embodimentRule: Independent reference chains must remain distinguishable in provenance.
machinery.failureExposure: Endpoint bias, stale gravimetry, reference poisoning.

machinery.function: Collapse topology cleanly and absorb residual fold ringing.
machinery.embodimentRule: Recovery reserve is protected from discretionary range use.
machinery.failureExposure: Closure rebound, ringing damage, sink saturation.

machinery.embodimentRule: Use minimum local coverage rather than vessel-wide average.

machinery.function: Provide independent timing, structural health, thermal sinks and abort path.
machinery.embodimentRule: Abort authority may not share a single failure domain with the primary fold controller.
machinery.failureExposure: Common-mode timing fault, abort denial, thermal overrun.

powerModel.rule: A longer fold is not modeled as a simple linear energy multiplier; topology conditioning, endpoint covariance, gravity burden, protected volume and recovery reserve alter event cost.
powerModel.reserve: E_reserve is protected until safe closure/recovery and cannot be consumed to extend nominal range.

candidatePipeline: continue re-solve until last safe commit instant
hardVetoes: structural authority below required fold boundary load
navigationControl.postCommitRule: After fold execution begins, navigation does not pretend to steer the ship through an intermediate path; machinery completes or safely collapses the topology event.

operations.title: Pre-Fold Certification
steps: arm but do not cross commit boundary until all independent channels agree

operations.title: Endpoint Covariance Growth
steps: reject any candidate whose confidence volume intersects exclusion geometry
abort spool if commit margin falls below certified minimum

operations.title: Controlled Precommit Abort
steps: dump shaped field into recovery sinks
maintain boundary coverage until residual gradient falls below service limit
log final candidate and rejection cause

operations.title: Post-Fold Recovery
steps: survey structural strain and boundary sectors
quarantine drive if closure residuals exceed certified envelope

maintenance.title: Topology Waveguide Geometry Certification
maintenance.method: Compare surveyed microgeometry against reference state and trend drift by sector.

maintenance.title: Endpoint Reference Audit
maintenance.method: Verify clock, gravimetric, astrometric and infrastructure provenance independently; do not average contradictory sources into one confidence score.

maintenance.title: Ringing Damper Test
maintenance.method: Inject bounded diagnostic impulse and compare decay spectrum against certified baseline.

maintenance.title: Coverage Continuity Test
maintenance.method: Exercise the complete protected-volume boundary including docking structures, repaired panels, deployed appendages and temporary modules.

signatures.rule: Improved technology may shorten or clean signatures but does not erase the topology event without higher authority explicitly establishing stealth behavior.

failureModels.name: endpoint-covariance-exceedance
failureModels.cause: Destination uncertainty exceeds certified arrival volume.

failureModels.name: occupancy-conflict
failureModels.cause: Protected destination volume intersects confirmed matter/traffic/structure.

failureModels.name: coverage-discontinuity
failureModels.cause: Part of intended payload lies outside certified fold boundary.

failureModels.name: topology-solution-bifurcation
failureModels.cause: Two or more adjacency solutions become comparably plausible near commit.
failureModels.response: Increase proof burden or abort; do not average endpoints.

failureModels.name: premature-commit
failureModels.cause: Topology execution begins before independent certification finishes.
failureModels.response: Recovery system attempts controlled completion/closure; root cause treated as control-safety failure.

failureModels.name: closure-ringing-overload
failureModels.cause: Residual topology energy exceeds damping authority.
failureModels.response: Isolate sectors, extend recovery, inspect structure before reuse.

failureModels.name: reference-poisoning
failureModels.cause: Authenticated-looking but stale/corrupted endpoint data biases solution.
failureModels.response: Invalidate affected reference chain and recompute from independent sources.

failureModels.name: gravity-conditioning-error
failureModels.cause: Unmodeled nearby mass/shear distorts the fold solution.
failureModels.response: Rebuild gravity model and reduce admissible range until covariance closes.

infrastructure.benefit: Improves authenticated endpoint state and covariance.
infrastructure.limit: Cannot override occupied-volume exclusion or shipboard field limits.
Does not make rapidly changing local conditions deterministic.

infrastructure.benefit: Provides surveyed test volumes for alignment, ringing and recovery certification.
infrastructure.limit: Certification ages with machinery and reference drift.

infrastructure.benefit: Publishes reserved arrival volumes and movement windows.
infrastructure.limit: Administrative clearance is not physical proof that the endpoint is empty.

scaling.protectedVolume: Field-forming burden grows with both boundary extent and internal geometry; irregular hulls and appendages can dominate coverage complexity.
scaling.structuralSpan: Larger ships require stronger distributed support and tighter differential-boundary control rather than merely a larger central core.
scaling.sensorBaseline: Longer baselines can improve endpoint and gravity estimation but increase synchronization and structural metrology burden.
scaling.multipleCores: Multiple fold cores are not additive range multipliers unless a higher-authority design defines coherent sectoring, staging or redundancy.

hardGuards: never infer race/manufacturer ownership from technology basis
never convert fold distance reduction into generic speed multiplier
never permit postcommit steering that contradicts recovered family action
never average an occupied endpoint into acceptability
never spend protected recovery reserve for nominal range
never promote DERIVED or PROPOSED details through repeated generation

confirmed: hard commit/no meaningful postcommit steering characteristic
legacy requirement for gravity-dependent error/efficiency and finite safety margins
proposed: all unsourced numeric coefficients and thresholds
unresolved: specific patent holders unless recovered elsewhere
